SPLLC: Single-Person Limited-Liability Company
An *identity* is a unique key pair.
Alice *trusts* Bob when she knows Bob personally and believes him to keep the undertakings he signs under grassroots contracts.
A *relation* is a friendship or the membership of a group. Bob *trusts* Carol, an organisation of Alice, when he trusts Alice. The *decision rule*, a parameter of GnW, says who decides for an organisation and how. Here: bylaws.
An *organisation* is a ward with *participants*, which include its *officers*, each with a *role*. The *bylaws*, a parameter of GO, name the roles of an organisation and say who decides each of its acts and how, their own amendment included. Here: single-person limited-liability company bylaws.
A *coin* is a unit of debt that includes its issuer's public key and is signed by their private key. An *Alice-coin* is a coin issued by Alice.
A *bond* is a unit of debt, due at its maturity date, that includes its issuer's public key and its maturity date and is signed by their private key. An *Alice-bond* is a bond issued by Alice. A bond is *mature* when its maturity date is at most the current date.
*Dollar* names one denomination, and a *Dollar-denominated Alice-coin* is an Alice-coin issued as Alice's debt of one Dollar.
A *Dollar-denominated Alice-bond* is an Alice-bond issued as Alice's debt of one Dollar, due at its maturity date.
A *corporation* is an organisation that holds, pays and issues Dollar-denominated coins and bonds.
A *single-person limited-liability company* is a corporation whose bylaws name one role, the *sole officer*, who decides every act of the company, and admit no participant but the sole officer.
Alice, Bob and Carol are persons. A party to a contract must have an identity. Alice and Bob are persons. Alice, Bob and Erin are persons, Carol and Dave organisations. Alice and Bob are persons, Orga an organisation.
GKK:1. ○ Establish: Alice may establish an identity once. Alice will make herself known by its public key, sign her acts with its private key, and be accountable for every act signed with it.
GKK:2. ■ Acquaint: Alice and Bob may jointly come to know each other.
GKK:3. ■ Introduce: Alice may introduce Carol to Bob with the consent of Bob, provided Alice and Bob know each other and Alice knows Carol.
GSG:1. ○ Befriend: Alice and Bob, who trust each other and are not friends, may jointly become friends.
GSG:2. ■ Unfriend: Alice may end her friendship with Bob.
GSG:3. ○ Loss of Trust. Alice will end her friendship with Bob if she ceases to trust him.
GnW:1. ■ Enter: Alice may create an organisation, Carol, and establish Carol's identity by choosing Carol's key pair. Alice is then the creator, an officer and a friend of Carol.
GnW:2, GO:4. ■ Officer decisions. Make officer: Those who decide for Carol may make Bob, a friend of an officer of Carol, an officer and a friend of Carol, with the consent of Bob, only if Bob is a participant; the decision names his role. Resign: Bob may end his guardianship of Carol. End officer: Those who decide for Carol, other than Bob, may end Bob's guardianship. Officer unfriend: Bob may end his friendship with Carol, which ends his guardianship. Carol may not end a friendship with her officer.
GnW:3. ■ Organisation and person. Organisation acquaint: Carol, an organisation of Alice, and Bob may jointly come to know each other. Organisation befriend: Carol may enter a relation with Bob with the consent of Bob and Alice, provided Carol and Bob know each other and Alice and Bob are friends. Organisation end, Unfriend, Organisation unfriend: Carol, Bob or Alice may end the relation of Bob and Carol.
GnW:4. ■ Organisations. Organisations acquaint: Carol, an organisation of Alice, and Dave, an organisation of Bob, may jointly come to know each other. Organisations befriend: Carol may enter a relation with Dave with the consent of Dave, Alice and Bob, provided Carol and Dave know each other, Alice knows Dave and is a friend of Bob, Alice and Bob possibly one person.
GnW:5. ■ Retire: Those who decide for Carol may retire Carol; every guardianship and relation of Carol then ends and Carol can take no act.
GO:1. ■ Found: An organisation may create Orga (GnW:1) with the consent of Alice; Alice is then its first officer.
GO:2. ■ Acts of the organisation. Propose: An officer, or a person the bylaws name, may propose an act of Orga. Vote: Those who decide the act may vote on it. Act: An officer the bylaws name for the act may take it for Orga after the votes decide it according to the bylaws.
GO:3. ■ Participation. Join: Bob may become a participant of Orga with the consent of those who decide for Orga. Leave, Expel: Either Bob or those who decide for Orga may end Bob's participation, and with it every role he holds.
GO:5. ■ Amend: Those who decide it may amend the bylaws.
GO:6. ○ Accountability. Orga will be accountable at law for its undertakings where it is a juridical person, and every officer who decided an act of Orga will be accountable for it with Orga.
GC:1. ■ Issue: Alice may issue Alice-coins.
GC:2, DGC:2. ■ Swap: Alice and Bob, who know each other, may jointly swap coins they hold, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination.
GC:3. ■ Pay: Alice may pay Bob-coins she holds to Bob, whom she knows.
GC:4, DGC:2. ■ Redeem: Alice may redeem a Bob-coin she holds against any coin held by Bob, whom she knows, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination.
GC:5. ○ Pricing. Alice will price her offerings in Alice-coins and accept them in payment at those prices.
GB:1. ■ Issue bond: Alice may issue Alice-bonds of a maturity later than the current date.
GB:2, DGC:2. ■ Swap: Alice and Bob, who know each other, may jointly swap coins and bonds they hold, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination.
GB:3, DGC:2. ■ Redeem: Alice may redeem a Bob-coin, or a mature Bob-bond, she holds against any coin or bond held by Bob, whom she knows, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination.
GB:4, DGC:2. ■ Escrow. Deposit: Alice may deposit coins and bonds with Carol for Bob, on a condition the three agree, with the consent of Carol, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination. Release: Carol and Bob may jointly release them to Bob if the condition is met, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination. Return: Carol and Alice may jointly return them to Alice if it fails, only if the coins and bonds are of one denomination. Each act is between two parties who know each other.
GDC:1. ■ Issue: Alice may issue Alice-coins denominated by a fiat currency.
GDC:2. ○ Denomination. A Dollar-denominated Alice-coin is due now; Alice will redeem it on presentation, by a Dollar-denominated coin the bearer accepts or by one Dollar.
GDC:3. ○ Pricing. Alice will accept Dollar-denominated Alice-coins in payment for her offerings at one Dollar each.
DGC:1. ■ Issue denominated bond: Alice may issue Alice-bonds denominated by a fiat currency, of a maturity later than the current date.
DGC:3. ■ Accept: Alice may accept Dollar-denominated Carol-coins in payment up to a limit of her choosing, if she holds a Dollar-denominated Carol-coin or Carol-bond; each such coin paid to Alice counts against the limit, and Alice may accept again.
DGC:4. ■ Pay accepted coins: Alice may pay Bob, whom she knows, coins she holds that Bob accepts.
